sections.title: Outlook
sections.about: A publisher's projections, as printed: growth, inflation and government debt, from the first year it projects to the last.

figures.label: Government gross debt, first projected year
Government gross debt, last projected year

sections.title: Other appraisals
sections.about: Other institutions' finished scores, each on its publisher's own scale and with its publisher's interval where one is printed. Nothing here is rescaled or combined.

figures.label: Political stability and absence of violence (World Bank WGI)
Country Policy and Institutional Assessment (World Bank CPIA)
Human Development Index (UNDP)
figures.note: UNDP recalculates the whole HDI series with each edition, so values from different editions are not comparable. Shown from the 2025 edition.

sections.title: Output and growth
sections.about: How large the economy is, how much it produces per person, and how fast and how steadily it grows.

sections.title: Prices and inflation
sections.about: How fast consumer prices rise now, on average lately, and at their worst on record.

figures.label: Highest inflation on record, at least 3 years apart

sections.title: Public finances
sections.about: What the state collects, how far it borrows, and how much it owes. What the country owes abroad is under Finance.

figures.label: Government debt
figures.unbound: WDI's central government debt covers 23 of the 54 states, the latest median 2019; IMF WEO general government debt comes with the WEO adapter

sections.title: Economic structure
sections.about: What the economy is made of, and how much it leans on oil, gas, minerals and natural resources.

sections.title: Jobs
sections.about: Modelled labour estimates. Where most work is informal, low unemployment can mean people cannot afford to be without work, so these are context, not a verdict.

sections.title: Monetary conditions
sections.about: How tight money is: what borrowing costs after inflation, what banks charge and pay, and how fast money grows.

sections.title: Currency and reserves
sections.about: How the currency has moved, how competitive it is, and how large a cushion of reserves stands behind it.

figures.label: Local currency per US dollar, average change a year over 5 years (+ is weaker)
Local currency per US dollar, average change a year over 10 years (+ is weaker)

sections.title: Banks
sections.about: How sound the banks are, how much they lend, at what margin, and how many adults use them.

figures.label: Change in credit to the private sector over 10 years

sections.title: Capital markets
sections.about: How deep and how active the stock market is. Many smaller economies have no exchange of their own, or share a regional one.

sections.title: Sovereign and external debt
sections.about: How heavily debt weighs: interest against revenue, what the country owes abroad, and what servicing it costs.

figures.label: Change in interest payments over 5 years
Change in debt service over 5 years

sections.title: Capital flows
sections.about: Which way money flows across the border: direct investment, portfolio money, remittances and aid.
